title: IT / Finance / Security Ops Sync
summary: Weekly ops sync to align IT, finance, and security on upcoming SOC 2 audit prep, VPC onboarding requests, and billing/PO cadence. Agreed next steps: share updated SOC 2 evidence tracker, prioritize two VPC requests for Q3, update billing runbook, and schedule a technical deep dive for VPC onboarding with Platform team.
topics: SOC 2 evidence tracker and audit timeline
Billing cadence, PO process, and invoicing errors
KMS/HSM key rotation and audit logs
Action items and next steps for pilot VPCs
action_items: Samir Khan: Export updated SOC 2 evidence tracker and send to Legal + Finance (due: 2025-05-20)
Priya Patel: Reconcile last quarter invoicing discrepancies, produce summary (due: 2025-05-16)
Jordan Lee: Spin up test VPC environment for Acme pilot and share access (due: 2025-05-27)
Maya Chen: Review evidence for redaction needs and advise on sharing policy (due: 2025-05-22)
next_steps: Samir to share SOC 2 evidence tracker link and short notes
Jordan to schedule VPC onboarding technical deep dive (invite Platform + Security)
Priya to circulate billing runbook and PO checklist
Set follow-up sync in two weeks to confirm pilot readiness
transcript:
Meeting header: 2025-05-13 14:00 PDT / Duration ~50m / Attendees: Alex, Priya, Samir, Jordan, Maya, Ethan, Leila, Tom

[00:00] Alex (IT): Okay, uh, good afternoon everyone. Thanks for jumping on. Quick check: is everyone seeing the agenda? I put the SOC 2 items top because audit is in six weeks.
[00:22] Priya (Finance): Yep, I can see it. Also wanted to flag one invoice issue from April before we get too deep.
[00:30] Samir (Security): Hi all. Quick heads up, I'm still waiting on a couple of evidences from Platform for the dev environment backups, but I can work with what we have.
[00:38] Jordan (Platform Ops): Sorry I was on another — I joined. Backups, yeah, I pinged infra yesterday. Might be a naming mismatch, K-V cache was logged as "K-V cash" in the export, so searching was funky.
[00:52] Maya (Legal): That's fine, we can handle mapping. Main ask from my side: any PII handling evidence should be redacted before shared externally.
[01:05] Ethan (CFO): Also, on billing: we've got two customers flagged where POs came late and we had to reissue invoices; want to tighten that process.
[01:18] Leila (Data Privacy): For the SOC 2 pieces, make sure key rotation logs and KMS/HSM access records are bundled. We saw gaps last cycle.
[01:30] Alex (IT): Right, Samir, can you walk through what you have and what's missing? We'll take notes on owners.
[01:38] Samir (Security): Sure. So I have: access reviews for engineering (Jan-Apr), patching window evidence for the prod cluster, and the incident log exports. Missing: backup verification for two dev clusters, and the key rotation proof for HSM for March — Platform said it was done but I don't have the proof artifact.
[01:55] Jordan (Platform Ops): The rotation proof is in the key-manager logs; we export in a slightly different format. I'll pull and standardize. Probably a CSV versus the JSON Samir expected.
[02:10] Priya (Finance): On invoicing, quick example: customer ACME, PO received late, invoice reissued, caused revenue recognition timing shift. I want a checklist so Finance can refuse to process incomplete PO metadata.
[02:28] Tom (Procurement): We should define minimal fields for acceptance — billing address, PO number, contract ID. If missing we auto-send a templated request.
[02:40] Samir (Security): Back to VPC onboarding requests — we have two high-priority ones: Acme pilot and a partner pilot. Both want dedicated VPC and private deployment. We need to confirm whether Dedicated or Private on-prem is needed; there's cost and compliance tradeoffs.
[02:59] Alex (IT): Let's triage them. Priya, what's the finance threshold for committing to dedicated capacity?
[03:06] Priya (Finance): For Dedicated we'd want a 3-month commit minimum for reserved capacity; otherwise it's a spike on hosted billing and it's expensive. For pilots, we can allow a month but need a PO and prepay.
[03:20] Ethan (CFO): Agree on prepay for pilots. We can set a clause for credit if we commit to longer term. Need clear SOW.
[03:31] Leila (Data Privacy): For the partner pilot, they require data residency in EU. That's a configuration question for Platform. Jordan, can we pin region and ensure logs remain in-region?
[03:43] Jordan (Platform Ops): Yes, we can pin region, but we need to ensure log forwarding and backup retention are set to EU endpoints. That changes where KMS keys live; need KMS replication or separate keys.
[03:58] Samir (Security): So two things: (1) confirm region + KMS plan; (2) ensure audit logs and key rotation evidence are captured. If we do distinct keys, we'll need explicit rotation proof per key.
[04:12] Alex (IT): Jordan, can you estimate time to produce a test VPC and share a walkthrough for Security to validate?
[04:20] Jordan (Platform Ops): I can have a test VPC up in about two weeks if no blockers, maybe quicker if we use existing infra as a template. I'll need a ticket and the pilot's specification.
[04:32] Samir (Security): Two weeks is fine, but we need read-only access for Security plus a way to fetch logs. Also would like a short on-call procedure if something looks off.
[04:45] Maya (Legal): On the evidence sharing, we'll need to review what we can share externally; some artifacts are internal-only. Samir, please tag any artifacts with sensitivity.
[04:55] Alex (IT): Good. Switching briefly to billing runbook: Priya, can you summarize the steps you want automated?
[05:02] Priya (Finance): Sure. Step 1: PO receipt and verification against contract ID; Step 2: Generate invoice based on committed capacity; Step 3: Run pre-billing check for duplicates and missing metadata; Step 4: If issue, auto-email requester with template. We need a single page checklist.
[05:20] Tom (Procurement): We'll take on creating the template and the required fields list.
[05:26] Ethan (CFO): Also want a monthly reconciliation task to detect PO mismatches early.
[05:33] Jordan (Platform Ops): A technical note: our billing exporter uses model/route labels; some older customers used freeform names so mapping to contract ID fails. We need canonical tagging.
[05:45] Samir (Security): That canonical tagging is also useful for access reviews. If resources are consistently tagged, audit takes less time.
[05:51] Leila (Data Privacy): Also, for PII, run a scan before artifacts go to the evidence bucket. We had one doc with embedded emails that should have been redacted.
[06:05] Alex (IT): Action: Samir export SOC tracker; Priya produce billing runbook; Jordan spin up VPC test. Who owns communication to customers about pilot billing?
[06:14] Priya (Finance): I'll draft the customer-facing billing note; Tom can review templated language.
[06:20] Tom (Procurement): Sounds good.
[06:25] Alex (IT): Anything else on SOC 2?
[06:29] Samir (Security): One more item: we need retention policy confirmation. Audit asked why some logs were purged at 90 days. We should have a documented retention schedule and exception process.
[06:40] Jordan (Platform Ops): Retention defaults are 90 days for dev, 365 for prod; we can change per environment, but need documented sign-off.
[06:50] Maya (Legal): Legal wants to be in the loop for retention exceptions, please route approvals.
[06:55] Alex (IT): Noted.
[07:00] [Time jump, 15m mark] Alex (IT): Back on VPC prioritization — we have Acme as top priority. Samir, what is Security's minimum for pilot acceptance?
[07:12] Samir (Security): Read-only logging, KMS keys with rotation evidence, and network ACLs. Also vulnerability scanning snapshot. If those are present, we give a green light for pilot.
[07:23] Priya (Finance): For Acme pilot, finance needs a PO and a signed SOW that includes a prepayment clause for the month. Without that, we can't provision Dedicated resources.
[07:35] Ethan (CFO): We can accept a digital PO if it contains the required fields, Tom will provide the template.
[07:42] Leila (Data Privacy): Clarify: will the Acme pilot use shared logs or separate logging buckets? We prefer separate to avoid cross-tenant exposure.
[07:53] Jordan (Platform Ops): We'll provision separate logging buckets per customer for pilots; production customers might use aggregated exports. Separate buckets mean slightly higher cost but better isolation.
[08:05] Samir (Security): Good. Also, when Jordan shares the test VPC, include a README with endpoints for log export and key location.
[08:15] Alex (IT): Let's talk timeline: Audit in six weeks; pilot readiness target for Acme is mid-June. Jordan, that aligns with two weeks to spin up the test VPC and another two weeks to validate?
[08:28] Jordan (Platform Ops): Yes, mid-June looks feasible. We'll try to accelerate if we can reuse infra templates.
[08:35] Priya (Finance): On invoicing errors, I will send a short list of customer invoice cases where metadata was missing; please treat as priority.
[08:44] Tom (Procurement): I'll add the PO acceptance criteria to the procurement playbook.
[08:50] Alex (IT): Quick note on tooling: Samir suggested a short audit-runbook for on-call engineers to follow when evidence is requested — like where to pull backups, naming conventions, and redaction steps.
[09:05] Samir (Security): I'll draft the runbook and share with Platform and Legal. We should version it in the internal repo.
[09:12] Maya (Legal): Please add a short paragraph about external sharing consent and what to redact.
[09:18] Leila (Data Privacy): Also include the PII-scan step.
[09:24] Alex (IT): Good. Anything else?
[09:27] Ethan (CFO): One question: Do we have clarity on the pricing model for Dedicated pilot versus Hosted? Because Finance needs an estimate for the PO.
[09:38] Jordan (Platform Ops): We have a draft pricing sheet. I'll send it after the call; it's per-GPU-hour plus a small management surcharge for dedicated pools. Nick from Sales might weigh in but I'll include an internal estimate.
[09:53] Priya (Finance): Please include expected token throughput assumptions — that drives cost.
[09:59] Jordan (Platform Ops): Will do.
[10:05] [Time jump, 30m mark] Alex (IT): Alright let's recap owners and deadlines. Samir?
[10:12] Samir (Security): I'll share the SOC 2 tracker by 2025-05-20 and tag artifacts with sensitivity.
[10:18] Priya (Finance): I'll send the billing runbook draft and the invoicing discrepancy list by 2025-05-16.
[10:24] Jordan (Platform Ops): I'll provision the test VPC for Acme and share access by 2025-05-27 and schedule the technical deep dive next week.
[10:33] Maya (Legal): I'll review evidence redaction rules and respond by 2025-05-22.
[10:38] Tom (Procurement): I'll produce the PO template and template email by 2025-05-19.
[10:44] Alex (IT): Great. Any blockers?
[10:49] Samir (Security): Just that Platform confirm log exports format; Jordan said he'd standardize.
[10:55] Jordan (Platform Ops): Yep, standardize to JSON lines with a mapping doc.
[11:02] Alex (IT): Cool. We'll set a follow-up in two weeks to verify progress. Thanks everyone.
[11:08] [End — 50:00 approx]

Notes: Transcript has occasional transcription errors (e.g., "K-V cash"), speaker overlap, and shorthand. Links shared during meeting: SOC 2 evidence tracker (internal link), VPC onboarding template (doc link), billing runbook draft (placeholder link).
